beginning.description: Prefix to prepend to generated passwords (default: empty)

end.description: Suffix to append to generated passwords (default: empty)

dictionary_file.description: Path to file with one password per line (enables dictionary mode)

min_length.description: Minimum password length (including beginning and end), >= 0

max_length.description: Maximum password length (including beginning and end), >= min_length

charset.description: Character set for exhaustive brute-force mode

verbose_interval.description: Print progress info every n seconds (0 disables periodic output)

state_file.description: Path to file used to save/restore session state

wallet_file.description: Path to encrypted wallet file to attack (required)
